home.subhead: RIVER & DELTA stations, STREAM series, OCEAN, solar, GLACIER, WAVE: independent guides, specs and comparisons to choose with confidence.
home.slideNewsExcerpt: Press roundups and editorial summaries to track the ecosystem.
home.feature1Text: Editorial analysis — not an official EcoFlow website. We do not resell products.
home.feature2Text: Capacity, use case, budget: straight to the choice, with limits and trade-offs shown.
home.feature3Text: Amazon affiliate links and ads are clearly disclosed, with cookie consent.
home.spotlightText: FR plug-in solar line (Ultra X, Pro, Max, micro-inverter) for balcony/home self-consumption — with or without storage.
home.editorialLead: We publish sheets and guides to help you decide: capacity (Wh), output (W), real use cases and budget — without fluff.
home.aboutTeaser: Who writes this, how we work, and how the site is funded:
home.howBody1: Each product sheet summarizes useful specs (Wh, W, weight, cycles, expandability) and a use-case take: camping, home backup, balcony solar, and more. This is a comparison tool, not a shop catalog.
home.howBody2: Guides explain the method (estimate usage, pick capacity, understand STREAM vs PowerStream). Comparisons help you choose between two buying logics and avoid common mistakes.
home.howBody3: Prices and stock move fast: our Amazon links open an up-to-date search. Always check electrical compatibility and local rules before installing solar.

powerstream.title: EcoFlow PowerStream guide
powerstream.subtitle: What the PowerStream micro-inverter does, who it's for, and what to check first.
powerstream.intro: EcoFlow's PowerStream turns a solar panel into household electricity with app monitoring. This guide covers the basics, limits, and buying questions.
powerstream.whatText: A micro-inverter that feeds solar power into your home circuit. Plugged into an outlet, it aims for simple self-consumption setup.
powerstream.forWhoText: Renters or homeowners who want to try solar without heavy works, on a controlled budget with app monitoring.
powerstream.check1: Real sun exposure on your facade / balcony / roof

guides.subtitle: Pick a portable station or solar kit for your real usage.
guides.buyersText: River, Delta, panels: size capacity (Wh), output (W), and recharge.
guides.campingText: Power a fridge, lights, and devices without a noisy gas generator.
guides.backupText: Outages, remote work, router: what you actually need to size.

guideBuyers.title: Buying guide: EcoFlow stations
guideBuyers.subtitle: Capacity, power, and recharge — the 3 numbers that matter.
guideBuyers.body1: Too small and it dies early; too big and it's pricey and heavy. Start from your devices (watts) and runtime (hours) to estimate Wh needed.
guideBuyers.body2: Also check outlets (AC, USB-C, car), AC/solar recharge speed, and expandability with extra batteries.

guideCamping.title: EcoFlow for camping & vans
guideCamping.subtitle: From 12V fridge to laptop: size without overbuying.
guideCamping.body1: List critical devices (fridge, lights, pump, phone charging). Multiply watts × hours for a daily Wh estimate.
guideCamping.body2: A foldable panel speeds daytime recharge. Prefer lighter units if you move often.

about.title: About EcoFlow Stream
about.meta: Who we are, editorial method, independence, and transparency on Amazon affiliate links and AdSense.
about.lead: EcoFlow Stream is an independent editorial site covering the EcoFlow ecosystem (portable stations, STREAM, PowerStream, OCEAN, solar and outdoor). Our goal is to help you choose with clear information — not to sell in your place.
about.missionBody: Make the specs that actually matter (Wh, watts, recharge, weight, expandability) easy to understand and map them to real use cases: camping, vanlife, backup, balcony solar. We prefer explanation and comparison over marketing slogans.
about.methodBody: We build pages from public specs, manufacturer documentation and realistic usage scenarios. We update the catalog when new lines appear (e.g. STREAM, DELTA 3).
about.method1: Structured sheets: pros/limits, specs and use cases.
about.method2: Practical guides: Wh sizing, camping, home backup.
about.method3: Comparisons: choose between models or families (e.g. STREAM vs PowerStream).
about.method4: Transparency: every affiliate purchase link and every ad is identifiable.
about.independenceBody: This site is not operated by EcoFlow Inc. or Amazon. Cited brands belong to their owners. Our copy is written for readers; an affiliate link does not change the price you pay.
about.monetizationBody: The site may show Google AdSense ads (after consent) and Amazon Associates affiliate links. These revenues fund hosting, maintenance and writing. They do not buy a favorable review.
